title: Al-Infitar 82:13-16 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Infitar, ghunnah and the sifat in practice
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Infitar 82:13-16 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 36. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ (١٣) وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ (١٤) يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ (١٥) وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ (١٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
And never therefrom will they be absent.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Izhar shafawi; then izhar (noon before ه)

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Infitar 82:13-16 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 82:13-16 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 82:13-16 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
Noon sakinah before ه, a throat letter: izhar.
A) In pleasure (na'im). 82:13: 'Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure.'

questions.q: Al-Infitar 82:13: «إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Al-Infitar compares the righteous (al-abrar) and the wicked (al-fujjar). What do you think makes a person one of the abrar?
questions.a: Iman, prayer, honesty and kindness, done sincerely for Allah.
